source_evidence_scope: Saved supplier_source.json and technical_preparation.json snapshots; photos fetched with GET from their exact stored SKU image URLs. Supplier SKU data was not refreshed from an authenticated API.
source_freshness_note: Görsel erişimi güncel olsa da SKU eşlemesi kaydedilmiş 2026-11-17 tedarikçi anlık görüntüsüne aittir; uygulanmadan önce güncel kaynakla yeniden eşleşmelidir.

contract.proposed_value_shape: dict[ASCII numeric product_id][ASCII numeric sku_id][existing exact aspect name] = nonempty string
contract.identity_format: [0-9]{6,}; int allowed only by exact str(int); bool/float/whitespace/prefix repair disallowed
contract.duplicate_guard: Do not override distinct pack/model/size SKUs to identical aspect combinations. variants.build can drop collisions when both human_override=True; no duplicate collapse has been authorized here.
contract.price_spread_rule: Retain review if active in-stock EUR max supplier cost / min supplier cost > 3.
contract.verification_limit: Actual unmodified parse_skus AST function and actual labels.py executed in memory only; full variants.build, pricing.settings, preparation, content gate and external APIs were NOT executed. No environment file was read.

visual_method: 61 SKU satırı, kaynakta bu SKU'lara bağlı 58 özgün fotoğraf üzerinden 13 kimlikli temas sayfasında görsel olarak incelendi. Temas sayfasının üst etiketleri kaynak metnidir; tek başına görsel kanıt sayılmadı.
